verdict.rationale: Baseten documents stable environments for development, staging, and production (baseten-docs-20). Truss provides a development loop with live reload whose model server behaves the same in development and production (baseten-gh-1, baseten-gh-3). Together these let users test deployments outside production, but the evidence is a single thin mention of environments and nothing addresses data isolation or a dedicated sandbox. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test mode, documentation on isolating test traffic and data from production, details on promoting between environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
